Elgyem

Psychic

Unova · Generation 5

Elgyem is a Psychic-type Cerebral Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 9 kg. It evolves into Beheeyem. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (85), with a base stat total of 335.
